events.title: Devlog 0: The story behind the game's idea and neighbors from I Have No Change
events.summary: A long time ago, following the challenging release of Torn Away, the studio perelesoq went bankrupt and began brainstorming their next game...We wanted to spend the next few years of our lives working on a game that tells important stories in settings we truly care about - just like Torn Away - but without the dark emotional weight.
